pages.text: These spectres are called and bound by your will to the point where their scythes won't cut either you or your allies.
One can call these creatures through the use of a $(l:focuses/necromancy/reaping_focus)Reaping Focus$(), or through a ritual which summons one without a limited lifespan.
Reapers can be healed by right-clicking on them with Ectoplasm.
